title: A/R Detail: a link with an unknown location ignores it
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  2. In the address bar, after {Location-A}'s code (the text after "locationIds="), add a comma and "Nowhere".
  3. Press Enter.
  4. In the address bar, replace everything after "locationIds=" with "Nowhere".
  5. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report narrows to {Location-A}, and the page address carries one "locationIds=" entry, {Location-A}'s code.
  • Step 2: the address bar shows {Location-A}'s code, a comma and "Nowhere" after "locationIds=".
  • Step 3: the report loads normally, with no error; the chip reads as if only {Location-A} were in the link ("Location: " and {Location-A}'s name), and the Location column is hidden, following the remaining choice.
  • Step 4: the address bar shows "Nowhere" after "locationIds=".
  • Step 5: the report loads normally, with no error; with no valid location left, the link opens on "Location: All locations" and the Location column shows (two locations in the list).

The tester edits only the list of locations in the page address.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-N2: “A location in a link that is not in the report's Location list (S5-R3), or is not a valid location at all, is ignored: the report loads, the chip reads as if it were not there, and the Location column follows the remaining choice.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D29: “Unknown or unresolvable customer/vendor/location ids in a link are dropped by the FE during the opening reconcile (resolve endpoint / option list) before any request, so the BE 422 is never reached from the UI”
  • Tech plan §6 Phase 1, unit tests: “invalid location ignored / all-invalid → All; pastDue=5 → Any;”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
